title: Ignite entryway illustration and step-pathway pack
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Create a compact, brand-forward visual system for the Quickstart landing that clarifies first-run steps and reduces time-to-success. Scope includes a new entryway hero illustration (light + dark modes), a step-pathway diagram (3 responsive breakpoints), modular screenshot placeholders for product states, motion guidelines for micro-interactions, and export-ready asset packs for engineering handoff. The work should resolve current cognitive load issues on the landing page (users uncertain which step to take next) and align with Console 2026 visual tokens. Deliverables: hero illustrations (2 colorways), 3 step-pathway SVGs (desktop/tablet/mobile), 6 annotated screenshots with device masks, copy callouts for each step, motion spec (Lottie / CSS guidance), accessibility checklist, dev export bundle (SVG/PNG/WEBP + token CSS/SCSS), and documented handoff in the Quickstart Refresh confluence page.
acceptance_criteria: Hero illustration exported in SVG + 3x PNG sizes for both light and dark tokens
Step-pathway diagram scales cleanly at desktop (1200px+), tablet (768-1199px), and mobile (<=767px) with accessible label sizes
Annotated screenshot set demonstrates 3 product states and matches the latest UI (links to sample builds provided)
Design tokens used (spacing, color, radius, type scale) are declared and map to frontend variables
Motion spec includes durations and easing, plus a fallback static state for reduced-motion users
Handoff folder with exports, alt-text proposals, and implementation notes is linked in the ticket
